say:1:1620106001:2.text: Aren't you a daredevil, hopping around on my grave all night?
say:1:1620106001:2.source_cn: 在墓园里作乱的时候不是胆子大得很吗？整夜整夜在棺材上跳...

say:2:1620106002:1.source_cn: 怎么，现在被抓了，知道害怕了？

say:3:1620106003:1.text: Spill it! Why are you disturbing my rest?
say:3:1620106003:1.source_cn: 说！为什么一直要在墓地捣乱，打扰我的安眠？

say:8:1620106005:1.text: I think your behavior is unacceptable! Chippy thought you'd do better!
say:8:1620106005:1.source_cn: 你……你怎么能做这种事呢？满满对你很失望！

choice_prompt:9:1620106005.text: I think your behavior is unacceptable! Chippy thought you'd do better!
choice_prompt:9:1620106005.source_cn: 你……你怎么能做这种事呢？满满对你很失望！

say:10:1620106006:1.text: Wait, why are you staring at me like that? You seriously think I'm the culprit?!
say:10:1620106006:1.source_cn: 等等，你们这是什么表情！你们该不会真的怀疑我吧？

say:11:1620106007:1.text: Dura above, I-I'm innocent! It's my first time here, and I was studying for my exam. I simply didn't have time for such monkey business!
say:11:1620106007:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我、我冤枉啊，今天是我第一次来这个墓园！而且...

say:12:1620106008:1.text: Are you talking about the Serene Lyceum's entrance exam?
say:12:1620106008:1.source_cn: 备考……你是说莱希拉姆的入学考试吗？

say:13:1620106009:0.text: That's right! Ever since we met at the Snowspire Festival, I've vowed to work hard and become a mage worthy of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s respect!
say:13:1620106009:0.source_cn: 没错！上次在冬日祭典和你们相遇后，我就决定，以后要努力...
say:13:1620106009:0.male: That's right! Ever since we met at the Snowspire Festival, I've vowed to work hard and become a mage worthy of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s respect!
say:13:1620106009:0.female: That's right! Ever since we met at the Snowspire Festival, I've vowed to work hard and become a mage worthy of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s respect!

say:14:1620106010:1.text: I've tried studying on my own, but it didn't go well... I'm determined to get into the Lyceum! Even after failing the exam four times, I'm ready to try again!
say:14:1620106010:1.source_cn: 但我后续的自学……呃，不太顺利……总之，我还是想上莱希...

say:15:1620106011:1.text: The exam's coming up, so I came to Savannah to get a head start on my preparations.
say:15:1620106011:1.source_cn: 最近莱希拉姆的入学考试又要开始了，所以我就离开了白山公...

say:16:1620106012:1.source_cn: 这一次，我一定要上莱希拉姆！

say:17:1620106013:1.text: Chippy admires your dedication, but... why are you studying in a graveyard?
say:17:1620106013:1.source_cn: 你的求学精神是很令人敬佩啦……可是，你为什么要在墓园里...

say:18:1620106014:1.text: History is one of the exam subjects, and it's all about learning the noble deeds of the great mages from the Lyceum.
say:18:1620106014:1.source_cn: 因为入学考试里的史学考试啊！这门考试会考莱希拉姆中伟大...

say:19:1620106015:1.text: I came here to look through the epitaphs... They might just help me ace the exam!
say:19:1620106015:1.source_cn: 所以我才来了墓园，这些碑文……说不定都是重要的考点呢！

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: （向维茨瓦夫投去失望的眼神！）

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: （向维茨瓦夫投去谴责的眼神！）
